- Option B: Tue 8 Apr, 09:00–10:00 CET / 00:00–01:00 PDT
- Option C: Tue 8 Apr, 16:00–17:00 CET / 07:00–08:00 PDT

If none of those fit, tell me 2 slots that do and I'll reissue a calendar invite with both Zoom and a backup bridge (we've seen Zoom regional routing be flaky for some customers).

I've attached a short post-call agenda and a small ICS bundle with the three proposed slots so you can drop one directly into your calendar: postcall-agenda.pdf, proposed-times.ics.

- Alex/Sara: confirm preferred slot (or share two alternatives)

Thanks — and apologies again for the delivery issue.
